title: webinar-integration.html
content: You can now manage your online {{variable.Object_Event}} s in Salesforce, using tools like Zoom, Vimeo, and GoToWebinar. Select your platform and add it directly to your existing {{variable.Object_Event}} management processes. Your {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will then be able to join webinars directly from their personalized {{variable.AttendeeLink}} . This makes it easy to run online {{variable.Object_Event}} s entirely in Salesforce. The most important benefit is keeping your online {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Object_Attendee}} data in Salesforce. We understand that can be challenging, even with the help of webinars and live-streaming solution integrations. Supported Platforms We currently support the following online video conferencing tools. Zoom GoToWebinar Webex Microsoft Teams - Populating the Event’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMtgURL}} field with the Teams meeting link lets {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s click the Join Stream button from their AttendeeLink. Vimeo Adobe Connect - Attendees must enable pop-ups or turn off ad blockers to access the webinar URL via their AttendeeLink. BlueJeans YouTube Live - If an Event’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMtgURL}} field includes a YouTube Live Stream URL, the URL must be in the following format: “http://www.youtube.com/live/[live stream id]”. If you want to use another provider, you can simply add the link to their {{variable.Field_Attendee_WebiMeetJoinURL}} field. That will take {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s to the URL to join the meeting. It will not update the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} but will connect the webinar to the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's {{variable.AttendeeLink}} . We officially support the paid versions of Zoom, GoToWebinar, and Webex natively within our app! FAQ Q: How do I create webinars from the {{variable.Tab_ET_BTEventAdmin}} tab? A: If you have many {{variable.Object_Event}} s and do not want to create a webinar for each manually, use the steps below to create a webinar for every {{variable.Object_Event}} where {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMeetingID}} = " ". In {{variable.Object_WebinarAccount}} s, authorize the platform of your choice. Add the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMeetingID}} field to each {{variable.Object_Event}} you want to add a webinar to. Click the {{variable.Tab_ET_BTEventAdmin}} tab. Click the {{variable.Tab_BTETAdmin_BatchJobs}} tab. Click {{variable.Button_CreateWebinarsEvents}} . Webinars will now be auto-generated without using the {{variable.Button_CreateWebinar}} button. Note: You can also add the {{variable.Field_Session_WebinarMeetingID}} field to {{variable.Object_Session}} s and click the {{variable.Button_CreateWebinarsSessions}} button to create a webinar for {{variable.Object_Session}} s. Q: Required Parameters Missing or Wrong A: This error occurs for GoToMeeting and Webex-based accounts that need to be reauthorized. There are two ways to resolve this. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_WebinarAccount}} record receiving the error. Click Authorize .   or Navigate to the {{variable.Tab_ET_BTEventAdmin}} tab. Click {{variable.Button_ET_ScheduleRecEventJobs}} . This will refresh the tokens for GTM and Webex every 29 days and ensure the error doesn't reappear.   Q: What happens if the webinar account refresh token expires? A: To ensure the webinar account refresh token doesn’t expire, schedule the Blackthorn | Event Webinar Account Refresh (WebinarAccountAuthRefresh) job. If the job is not included in the list of Apex Classes, follow the steps below to add it.  Click the {{variable.Button_GearIcon}} .  Click {{variable.Button_Setup}} .  In the Quick Find box, enter and click “Apex Classes.” Click Schedule Apex . Complete the following fields. Job Name Apex Class = “WebinarAccountAuthRefresh” (If you don’t know the exact name, click the magnifying glass and search for the name in the pop-up window.) Set the Frequency to run daily. ("Weekly" + "Sunday," "Monday," "Tuesday," "Wednesday," "Thursday," "Friday," "Saturday," and "Sunday") Start date End date Preferred Start Time Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Q: How do I change the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMtgURL}} for an existing {{variable.Object_Event}} if the {{variable.Object_Event}} already has a  {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMtgURL}} ? A: Complete the steps below t o change the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMtgURL}} link for an {{variable.Object_Event}} or {{variable.Object_Session}} that has an existing {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMtgURL}} . Go to the {{variable.Object_Event}} or {{variable.Object_Session}} record. Delete the URL in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMtgURL}} field. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Click the Create a Webinar/Meeting button. Confirm the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ZoomType}} . Click Create . A new URL be added to the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMtgURL}} field. LIMITATIONS Existing {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can only access the original {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMtgURL}} via their {{variable.AttendeeLink}} . If an existing {{variable.Object_Attendee}} clicks the Add To Calendar button, the original {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMtgURL}} will be added to the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's calendar. Only {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s who are registered after the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMtgURL}} was updated will have access to the new {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMtgURL}} . Q: How do I remove Zoom? A: To remove your Zoom authorization from your {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} org, please complete the following steps. Navigate to https://marketplace.zoom.us/ and log in. Click Manage in the top right corner. Click Installed Apps under My Dashboard. Click Uninstall on Blackthorn Events. Done! Zoom and Blackthorn Events will no longer be linked. Q: If I’m working in the Event Builder, which fields can I change to regenerate a new Zoom webinar link? A: When editing an Event in the Event Builder, Zoom webinar links will be regenerated only when the following fields on the Event or Session records are changed. A new Zoom link will not be created when any other fields are modified. Event  {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinMeetingAcct}}   {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventStartDate}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndDate}}   {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventStartTime}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndTime}} Session  {{variable.Field_Session_WebinarMeetiAcct}} {{variable.Field_Session_StartDate}}   {{variable.Field_Session_EndDate}}   {{variable.Field_Session_StartTime}}   {{variable.Field_Session_EndTime}}
